risk_factors.heading: Environmental, health and safety laws and liabilities
risk_factors.quote: We cannot assure you that we have been or will be at all times in complete compliance with such laws, regulations and permits. If we violate or fail to comply with these laws, regulations or permits, we could be fined or otherwise sanctioned by regulators.

risk_factors.heading: Climate change initiatives may raise production costs
risk_factors.quote: Public and private initiatives to address climate change may result in an increase in the cost of production due to increase in the prices of energy, introduction of energy or carbon tax or the purchase of carbon offsets.

risk_factors.heading: Interruptions in IT systems could adversely affect business
risk_factors.quote: Any significant interruption in our business applications, systems or networks, including but not limited to new system implementations, computer viruses, cyberattacks, security breaches, facility issues or energy blackouts could have a material adverse impact on our business

risk_factors.heading: Security breaches and cybersecurity incidents
risk_factors.quote: We have, from time to time, experienced cyber-attacks attempting to obtain access to and misuse our computer systems and networks. Such incidents could result in the misappropriation of our proprietary information and technology

risk_factors.heading: Cybersecurity and privacy laws
risk_factors.quote: As a global enterprise, we could also be impacted by existing and proposed laws and regulations, as well as government policies and practices related to cybersecurity, privacy and data protection.

risk_factors.heading: Inability to protect proprietary intellectual property
risk_factors.quote: It is possible that competitors or other unauthorized third parties may obtain, copy, use or disclose our proprietary technologies, our products, designs, processes and other intellectual property despite our efforts to protect our intellectual property.
